propositions: The live tickets branch .bridge_state/projects.json was overwritten with rehearsal fixture keys (LEG, ONE, TWO, ZERO) that do not exist in live Jira, causing the Reconcile Bridge scheduled action to fail consistently since 2026-08-15T02:39Z.

The fetcher multi-project fan-out (story-1734) issues a JQL query for every key in projects.json; when LEG is queried as 'project = LEG AND status != "Done"', Jira rejects it with 'value leg does not exist for field project' and ACLI exits 1, aborting the reconcile pass.
The corruption was introduced by ad-hoc git commits (9f1b2cff98, 275bd7507e) authored with test-fixture identity on the live tickets branch, not through the isolated rehearsal harness.
The canonical known-good state is {"version": 1, "legacy_default": "REB", "projects": {}} (empty projects), which falls back to single-project [REB] and avoids the non-existent key fan-out.

A preflight validation must verify every mapped project key and legacy_default exists in live Jira before any mutation, and bridge-state writes must be placed under the shared write lock with commit and push to prevent ad-hoc corruption.
The per-project fan-out must be resilient so that one unmapped key does not abort the entire pass, allowing graceful degradation instead of total failure.
